claim_boundary.domain: THOS coordination, source refresh, watcher/readiness, and roadmap synthesis

reflection_steps.finding: Treat v49 and older Journey records as continuity memory, not empirical proof.
Separate official implementation sources from inspirational or historical material.
Prefer local app-server probe plus targeted retry over duplicate all-lane starts.
Keep Arby and Aster non-ephemeral, read-only, and watched through metadata receipts.
Use completion receipts as durable handoff markers rather than terminal scrollback.
Index command surfaces before expanding them; discovery must precede mutation.
Surface v54/v55 handoffs as manifests and open gaps, not archive dumps.
Map Windows sandbox mode to actual observed command behavior before claiming readiness.
Use guardrails before every publication, even when artifacts are self-generated.
Exact staging is not bureaucracy; it is the mechanism that preserves unrelated user work.
Drive context can name titles and continuity pointers without publishing restricted payloads.
Remote equals local is the repo truth source for shared omega publication.
MCP tools need resource/output discipline before they become safe THOS surfaces.
Agent frameworks should be mapped to explicit transports and execution boundaries.
Local AI hardware research belongs in capacity planning, not miraculous capability claims.
Cloud agent architecture helps design orchestration, but deployment requires separate approval.
Helper scripts should use list-form subprocess calls and redacted receipts.
Restricted token and MIC details clarify why sandbox setup must be observed, not assumed.
Container watch patterns are useful as analogies for bounded, observable runner refresh.
Job/CronJob semantics warn that retries and duplicate starts must be idempotent.
Trace/metric/log vocabulary can upgrade THOS watcher receipts into observability artifacts.
LLM application risk framing should inform connector and prompt-surface hardening.
Skill indexes should publish metadata and routing, not full skill body copies.
Plugin surfaces stay read/use-only unless a separate exact mutation packet exists.
THOS can support GMUT tooling, but it does not close physics gates by association.
Any simulation or fixture output needs explicit simulation labeling.
Large roadmaps must be executable slices, not decorative task piles.
A blocker should be classified, retried safely, and then recorded if it persists.
x3/x4 overlays are justified only by real blocker handling or hardening needs.
Every closeout should preserve next phase, evidence, blockers, and claim ceiling.
